stories.title: 13 ilde sahte belgelerle vatandaşlık operasyonu: 26 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: Citizenship operation with forged documents in 13 provinces: 26 suspects arrested
en.summary: Operations across 13 provinces centered in Istanbul resulted in 74 suspects being detained for allegedly granting Turkish citizenship to approximately 1,070 foreign nationals using fake property documents and generating 72.25 million dollars in illegal gains. Of those referred to prosecutors, 26 were arrested while 48 were released under judicial supervision.
